generationPromptZh: 一个带四轮、侧窗、车门和箱形驾驶区的公交车。它由底盘、载客舱、侧窗、车门和四个轮子组成。轮宽约为底盘宽的0.20倍，左右前后轮根连接底盘。宽深比约0.76，高/最大水平跨度约0.59；驾驶端位于车体前侧，轴距与车长比0.69。实测采用4种不透明颜色，车顶以蓝灰色为主，前窗呈青色。正视看前侧轮廓，侧视看纵深及附件连接，俯视看水平排列和间距；斜视同时显示前面、右侧与顶部，孔隙与接合均来自实体几何。 采用彩色体素。坐标为0至47的整数，X左右、Y向上、Z前后；实际接地最低Y为0。占用750至1250个唯一体素，RGB为0至255整数；保持单一六邻域连通、真实开口及面连接。不要添加展示底板、文字、背景、噪声或悬浮装饰。 原始参数规格：{"baseWidthFraction": 0.55, "category": "bus", "changedAttributes": ["width", "depth", "height", "supportInset", "shapeChamfer", "featureCount"], "construction": "original continuous boxes and chamfered cross sections", "depth": 22.0, "detailPosition": 0.25, "doorFrameGlazing": true, "featureCount": 2, "height": 10.0, "instance": 0, "lipOverhang": 0.6, "neckFraction": 0.42, "ordinal": 53331, "redesign": 0, "rimHeight": 2.0, "shapeChamfer": 0.0, "shoulderFraction": 0.58, "structureIndex": 0, "style": 0, "supportInset": 1.0, "variant": 1, "wallThickness": 2.0, "width": 12.0}

Wheel width is 0.20 chassis-widths; front/rear pairs connect on both sides. Width/depth is 0.76; height/horizontal-span is 0.59. The driving end faces forward. Axle-gap/depth is 0.69. Across 4 opaque colors, the roof is mainly blue-gray and the windshield is cyan. Front and side views expose contours and attachment joins; top and oblique views reveal spacing and upper surfaces. Use colored voxels at unique integer coordinates from 0 through 47, with X left to right, Y upward and Z front to back. Real ground contact starts at Y zero. Use 750 through 1250 occupied voxels and integer RGB values from 0 through 255. Keep one six neighbor component, real openings and face connected parts. Add no display base, text, background, noise or floating ornaments.
